Claims must tie back to repository docs, demo evidence, tests or Control Plane artifacts.
role_goal: prepare evidence-backed outreach assets without external sending or unsupported fundraising claims

must_cover: Wave 0 manual validation and Wave 1 segmentation
CRM schema with source and opt-out fields
